description: This PHP source file defines a REST API controller class 'InstallerDataRegistrationAPI' within the OrangeHRM installer module. The class handles POST requests to perform data registration during the installation process, utilizing various utility classes and services for registration data management and state handling.

classes.name: InstallerDataRegistrationAPI
classes.description: REST API controller handling data registration requests during installation, designed to respond to POST requests with registration status messages.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the service and utility dependencies used by the controller.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to perform registration data sending, manages registration state, and returns success or failure status messages.
